```lean
CategoryTheory.Limits.mkFanLimit.{w, v, u} {β : Type w} {C : Type u} [Category.{v, u} C] {f : β → C} (t : Fan f)
  (lift : (s : Fan f) → s.pt ⟶ t.pt) (fac : ∀ (s : Fan f) (j : β), lift s ≫ t.proj j = s.proj j := by aesop_cat)
  (uniq : ∀ (s : Fan f) (m : s.pt ⟶ t.pt), (∀ (j : β), m ≫ t.proj j = s.proj j) → m = lift s := by aesop_cat) :
  IsLimit t
```

just a convenience lemma to avoid having to go through `Discrete`
